title: Media Bias Detector: Designing and Implementing a Tool for Real-Time Selection and Framing Bias Analysis in News Coverage
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and evaluation of an LLM-driven tool to detect media bias in news. While 'Religion' appears as one of many subtopics in the news category hierarchy for the tool's classification system, the paper does not deal with evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research.
